cards.front: energy
cards.back: What makes things happen. It is needed to move, heat and light things.
cards.say: energy. What makes things happen. It is needed to move, heat and light things.

cards.front: Can energy be used up?
cards.back: No. Energy is never used up, only moved from one place or form to another.
cards.say: Can energy be used up? No. Energy is never used up, only moved from one place or form to another.

cards.front: energy transfer
cards.back: When energy moves from one place to another or changes form.
cards.say: energy transfer. When energy moves from one place to another or changes form.

cards.front: Name a form of energy.
cards.back: Light, sound, heat, movement, electrical or chemical.
cards.say: Name a form of energy. Light, sound, heat, movement, electrical or chemical.

cards.front: light energy
cards.back: Energy given out by the Sun or a lamp.
cards.say: light energy. Energy given out by the Sun or a lamp.

cards.front: sound energy
cards.back: Energy carried by vibrations.
cards.say: sound energy. Energy carried by vibrations.

cards.front: heat (thermal) energy
cards.back: Energy that makes things hot.
cards.say: heat (thermal) energy. Energy that makes things hot.

cards.front: kinetic energy
cards.back: Energy of movement.
cards.say: kinetic energy. Energy of movement.

cards.front: chemical energy
cards.back: Energy stored in food, fuels and batteries.
cards.say: chemical energy. Energy stored in food, fuels and batteries.

cards.front: electrical energy
cards.back: Energy carried by electricity in a circuit.
cards.say: electrical energy. Energy carried by electricity in a circuit.

cards.front: Where does most of the energy on Earth come from?
cards.back: The Sun.
cards.say: Where does most of the energy on Earth come from? The Sun.

cards.front: What energy transfer happens in a lit torch?
cards.back: Chemical energy in the battery becomes electrical energy, then light and some heat.
cards.say: What energy transfer happens in a lit torch? Chemical energy in the battery becomes electrical energy, then light and some heat.

cards.front: What energy transfer happens when you rub your hands?
cards.back: Movement energy becomes heat energy.
cards.say: What energy transfer happens when you rub your hands? Movement energy becomes heat energy.

cards.front: What energy transfers in a toaster?
cards.back: Electrical energy becomes heat energy.
cards.say: What energy transfers in a toaster? Electrical energy becomes heat energy.

cards.front: What energy transfers in a loudspeaker?
cards.back: Electrical energy becomes sound energy.
cards.say: What energy transfers in a loudspeaker? Electrical energy becomes sound energy.

cards.front: What energy transfers in a bulb?
cards.back: Electrical energy becomes light and heat.
cards.say: What energy transfers in a bulb? Electrical energy becomes light and heat.

cards.front: What energy transfers when we eat food?
cards.back: Chemical energy in food becomes movement and heat in our body.
cards.say: What energy transfers when we eat food? Chemical energy in food becomes movement and heat in our body.

cards.front: What does a plant do with the Sun's energy?
cards.back: It uses light energy to make food, which stores chemical energy.
cards.say: What does a plant do with the Sun's energy? It uses light energy to make food, which stores chemical energy.

cards.front: wasted energy
cards.back: Energy that is not useful. It often spreads out as heat.
cards.say: wasted energy. Energy that is not useful. It often spreads out as heat.

cards.front: Why is some energy wasted in a bulb?
cards.back: A lot of electrical energy becomes heat, not light.
cards.say: Why is some energy wasted in a bulb? A lot of electrical energy becomes heat, not light.

cards.front: How can we waste less energy?
cards.back: Turn things off, use efficient bulbs and use insulation.
cards.say: How can we waste less energy? Turn things off, use efficient bulbs and use insulation.

cards.front: True or false: Energy is created when we burn fuel.
cards.back: False. It is transferred from the stored chemical energy.
cards.say: True or false: Energy is created when we burn fuel. False. It is transferred from the stored chemical energy.

cards.front: Which is a source of energy, wind or a chair?
cards.back: Wind.
cards.say: Which is a source of energy, wind or a chair? Wind.

cards.front: renewable energy
cards.back: Energy from sources that will not run out, such as the Sun, wind and water.
cards.say: renewable energy. Energy from sources that will not run out, such as the Sun, wind and water.

cards.front: What happens to the energy in a moving car when it stops?
cards.back: It is transferred to the surroundings as heat and sound.
cards.say: What happens to the energy in a moving car when it stops? It is transferred to the surroundings as heat and sound.
